description: Find brands that share operators/sellers with a target brand. Returns brands ranked by how many operators they share. Use when the user asks 'what brands are in X's network?', 'brands related to Ninja', 'who else do Ninja's sellers carry?', 'brands in the same seller network', or 'brand family'. This reveals the operator graph — brands connected through shared distribution channels.

brand.description: The target brand to find network connections for.

brand_contains.description: Only keep related brands whose name contains this substring.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

min_shared_operators.description: Only related brands sharing at least this many operators.

name: brands_in_operator_network
